iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::geo
       Returns L3 geoIP and geolocation collected by client.

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::geo

DESCRIPTION
       Returns L3 geoIP and geolocation collected by client.

RETURN VALUE
		   Returns L3 geoIP and geolocation collected by client.

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_ALERT {
	    log local0. "geolocation: [ANTIFRAUD::geo]."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-15.0.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
